metadata.name: guided-readonly-triage
metadata.description: Allow guided findings reads on review hosts while making mutation tools an explicit deny.

rules.description: Allow the MCP client to discover the triage surface.
rules.reason: Discovery is required before the operator can select readonly triage tools.

rules.description: Allow findings reads and comparisons for approved review hosts.
rules.reason: Readonly triage clients may inspect findings and report artifacts without mutating scan state.

rules.description: Allow bounded report previews and pages within the caller's report workspace; these calls do not carry a target host.
rules.reason: Report reads enforce the caller's artifact-directory boundary.

rules.description: Make state-changing guided tools an explicit deny regardless of later bundle mistakes.
rules.reason: Readonly triage clients may not start scans, mutate auth/context state, or rewrite ZAP scan policies.
